image_description: A close-up, low-light photograph of a pile of baked goods. The items appear to be bagels or bagel-like rolls, characterized by a golden-brown, glossy crust. One item in the foreground is twisted and topped with sesame seeds. Another item behind it shows a classic ring shape with a central hole. The lighting is warm and directional, creating strong highlights on the shiny surfaces and deep shadows.
